Direct Known Subclasses:
BlockEntityChestCoreNeoForge
public class BlockEntityChestCore extends net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntity implements net.minecraft.world.MenuProvider, ChestUpgradeInventory.Owner, IChest
Block entity of a chest core: owns the storage and the cached structure. While the structure is broken the core is dormant: contents stay, but its item storage is not exposed.
